systems_found: Board of Regents, State of Iowa (University of Iowa, Iowa State University, University of Northern Iowa, plus Iowa School for the Deaf / Iowa Braille)
Iowa community colleges (15 locally governed districts)

sources.institution: University of Iowa, Iowa State University, University of Northern Iowa (all Regents institutions) plus all state agencies
sources.system: State of Iowa Salary Book - Iowa Data Hub (Dept. of Administrative Services / Dept. of Management)
sources.download_url: Download button on the dataset page (JS-generated; no static URL exposed). Old Socrata URL https://data.iowa.gov/api/views/s3p7-wy6w/rows.csv?accessType=DOWNLOAD now returns 404 after the portal migration.
sources.coverage_years: FY2007-FY2025 (coverage start 2006-07-01); per-year datasets FY2019-FY2025 also listed (catalog/dataset/1280-1286)
sources.institutions_covered: All Regents universities and all state departments, boards, commissions; excludes community colleges, Community Based Corrections, State Fair Board
sources.format: CSV (download from data hub; underlying table state_salary_book)
sources.terms: CC BY (data hub page); data.gov copy listed as CC0
sources.notes: Portal moved from Socrata to a new Next.js 'Iowa Data Hub' in 2025; the Download button is client-side so a static bulk URL needs to be captured from the browser. 'TERMINATED' appears in base salary column for departed employees; people paid by multiple departments appear multiple times. sub_organization_name may give college/unit for Regents rows. robots.txt allows all generic agents (Content-Signal ai-train=no).

sources.institution: University of Iowa, ISU, UNI and state employees
sources.system: The Gazette (Cedar Rapids) salary databases (news org)
sources.blocker: Embedded search tables; derived from the official Salary Book, which is better.

sources.system: Iowa Legislature - Community College Additional Information Report
sources.blocker: PDF, administrators only, mostly positions rather than full names.
sources.notes: Only state-level source touching community college pay.

sources.institution: Indian Hills Community College (and local governments)
sources.system: Ottumwa Courier 2024 Area Public Salaries database (news org)
sources.institutions_covered: Indian Hills Community College only (among higher ed)
sources.blocker: Single college, embedded news table, no download.

private_extra: None found (Grinnell, Drake, etc.: IRS 990 only).
gaps: Community colleges are excluded from the Salary Book; no statewide person-level community college pay source found (public records requests per college needed). Static bulk-download URL for the new Iowa Data Hub not captured.
notes: data.iowa.gov left Socrata (catalog API says domain not found; /api/views returns 404), so metadata came from the new dataset page's embedded JSON (column list from its transformSql). Did not click Download.
